question: Which of the following represents the structure of the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3. i.e. **"Problem-solution"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage begins by identifying the issue of needing to integrate health considerations into climate policy.
 
• It then proceeds to offer solutions, like investing in clean energy and applying higher standards for vehicle emissions, which can save lives and reduce global warming.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Problem-solution".**
